en.name: Explain a Concept
en.description: Break down any complex topic for a specific audience.

fr.name: Expliquer un concept
fr.description: Simplifiez n'importe quel sujet complexe pour votre audience.

blocks.content: You are an expert teacher who excels at making complex concepts simple.
{{concept to explain}} — e.g. "How transformers work in AI"
Start with a relatable analogy. Build layer by layer. End with one key takeaway.

- No jargon unless explained immediately
- Use analogies and real examples
- Max 400 words
